principle: A plausible plot, successful import, fitted scale or replay of calibration data cannot qualify a beamtime predictor.

requires: Exact instrument cycle, guide, chopper frequency, wavelength band and grouping
Immutable raw/reduced hashes and Mantid reduction recipe/version
Specimen identity reviewed independently of reusable acquisition sample IDs
Authoritative structure, composition/isotopes, temperature and phase fractions
Mass, packing/fill geometry, illumination and environment documented with units
Proton charge, proton energy, beam power and monitor provenance
Measured incident wavelength spectrum and detector-angle/efficiency coverage
Resolution kernels checked against standards on each supported configuration
Vanadium/reference, empty-can and environment contributions propagated
Source-energy yield changes calibrated rather than inferred from MW alone
Absorption, resonances, multiple scattering and texture validated over declared sample domain
Freeze models, masks, thresholds and exclusions before confirmatory outcomes are read
Whole-specimen/material-family and proposal separation with uncertainty in identity resolved
Independent standards/materials spanning masses, absorption, incoherent scattering, environments and instrument modes
No target-specific fitted scale, background, profile or structural parameters in absolute prediction scores
Report all eligible and failed cases, plus uncertainty clustered by physical specimen
Correct exposure dependence of means, peak-integrated variances and joint covariance
Finite shared vanadium, background and monitor-reference uncertainty
Signed and zero-count observations retained under the stated likelihood
Repeated independent acquisitions compared with raw-event or matched-reduction predictions
Validate cumulative-count dependence and any proposed stopping rule on independent acquisitions
Predeclared interval coverage and beamtime-error targets assessed per stratum, not pooled bins
Zero moments reproduce parent and doubled moments multiply magnetic intensity by four
Independent coordinates map exactly to saved allowed site moments in each embedding
Zero displacement modes reproduce parent, including supercell density, ADPs and profile broadening
Nonzero modes and symmetry-preserving lattice strain reproduce independently established structural transitions
Measured magnetic and structural standards span nonzero k, supercells, domains, form factors and moment directions
Isotope scattering, absorption, density and mass checked against independently documented enriched specimens
Run the complete declared acceptance suite in the deployed native runtime
Independent review of physical reference provenance and acceptance thresholds
Publish per-configuration validity domain and measured errors
Do not enable validated beamtime recommendations until all relevant gates pass

current_known_gaps: No independent absolute-intensity qualification corpus with verified structures and illumination
No experimentally qualified current-cycle count response
Observed regional repeat variance exceeds the independent-bin approximation
2011B and 2013A legacy PAB lookup tables are unavailable
Structural discovery constructs a bounded highest-symmetry-per-irrep tier and records deferred branches
Incommensurate/modulated phases and anisotropic parent-ADP transfer are unsupported

Declared crystalline mass-fraction mixtures are implemented and have a native 80/20 installation control, but experimental mixture transfer, specimen homogeneity and phase fractions remain unqualified
Native transition controls are implementation checks; measured transition prediction remains unqualified

capability_status_revision.reason: Correct the obsolete statement that all multiphase nuclear samples are unsupported; distinguish implemented controls from experimental qualification.
